sections.title: New
items: Admins in private village siege rehearsals can switch maps from the Escape menu. Each map keeps the attacker roster, has AI defenders, and starts with a 15-second warmup.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Barricades use Bannerlord's wooden siege barricade. Barricades and stakes have 200 HP and show the standard health bar when targeted after taking damage.
Carry up to four Barricade or Stakes Kits in any mix. Each side can have up to 15 barricades and 15 stake barriers standing at once.
Teammates can damage and destroy their side's deployables.

sections.title: New
items: Added support for test sieges on Praven, Quyaz, Hongard, Husn Fulq, and Galend.
Test sieges can use human defenders or the castle's AI garrison.

sections.title: New
items: Added Barricade and Stake Barrier kits for Strategus battles.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Portable ladders can be destroyed. Placing one ladder on top of another is blocked.
Restored the marker above the last fighter when their team runs out of reserve tickets.
The Strategus scoreboard stays visible when the battle ends.
Fixed the in-game toggle for hiding the combat log.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Healing Tents and Forward Spawns have a five-minute relocation cooldown.
Five or more nearby enemies are required to block a Forward Spawn.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Cancel Application is hidden for battle owners. Volunteers can still withdraw while applications are open.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Prepared launcher support for a third campaign battle server and backend support for clearing cancelled battles.

sections.title: Fixed
items: When the battlefield is full, reinforcements wait for room without spending a life or equipment.
Old riderless horses are cleared when a battle gets close to the agent limit.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The Strategus scoreboard shows nobility badges in the Rank column. Player and commander names use Warlords-style clan tags when enabled.
Scoreboard text is two points smaller.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed a collision buffer that could crash the server during Forward Spawn, equipment placement, or map checks.
After a failed spawn, the server checks that the soldier is still in the battle before removing it.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Updated multiplayer support for Bannerlord 1.5.7.
The battle loadout panel initializes its equipment slots and character preview before it opens.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Armoury stock updates do less work while the loadout panel is closed.
Campaign servers reuse roster checks when updating team counts and pings.
